title: DOC: more complete gantt example
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Adding to the bottom of the gantt page. Includes samples across different pages that are missing from this page - comments, frontmatter,  directives, and customizations.

Resolves ... several hours worth of research I was doing, formatting, experimenting.

One point of confusion is the Gantt [Configuratio section](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html). There are many references to using the CLI and the JSON objects, and most places in the documentation reference 'config' using scripting, while no mention of frontmatter or directives on the page. 

Obviously this might generate some discussion and edits - happy to chat!

Thanks for your considerations 👌


## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Wanted to provide a comprehensive example with the correct terms to be able to loook up. A lot of these are otherwise hard to find.

Written and tested over several sessions for fresh eyes, and using the live editor and Windows app.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [-] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [-] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.

comments.body:

We can add it in the frontmatter config section of the docs.

comments.author: generrosity
comments.body:
I'm keen to find somewhere easy to reach. It took an unusually long time to find, and just wanted to start with a "small" edit. 

Many little things like 'Diagram Syntax - Syntax and Configuration'  doesn't mention "frontmatter",  'Deployment' has much better post deploy syntax. Many little things which a quick lick could greatly help someone unfamiliar.


Thanks again for reading through, I'm just hoping I can shave a few hours off other people's searches 😁

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
String quoting is purely YAML syntax dependent.

```suggestion
Frontmatter uses YAML syntax. It requires any indentation to be consistent and settings are case sensitive. Mermaid will silently ignore misspelling, but badly formed parameters will break the diagram. 
```
comments.label_reasoning: The comment corrects inaccurate documentation about frontmatter/YAML syntax, providing a more precise description of behavior.
